levels.surface: إبراهيم بن عبد الله بن حنين

notes: Braces mark an editor's insertion: the name is written «ابن، وهب»; the glosses «- هو ابن بلال -» and «- هو ابن أبي نمر -» are left out
The second isnad («قال شريك وأخبرني أبو سلمة») comes right after the first and carries the same matn: a second group sharing the head up to شريك
The first isnad stops at علي, with no words of his own; the matn follows the second isnad
